what_this_is: Relevance of every claim the shipped system (uncitable claims withheld after generation) displayed on the frozen 134-question probe set, judged against the QUESTION it was shown for. Model-judged, two blind passes plus adjudication, with a question-derangement control arm. NOT human validation; the 40-item author-graded sheet is, and its agreement is reported under human_check when available.

provenance.arm: the shipped system (uncitable claims withheld after generation)

judge.decoding: not set; harness defaults, so the passes are not bitwise reproducible
judge.model_checkpoint: NOT RECOVERABLE: no script pins a model, so each judge subagent inherited the session's model. Family is Anthropic Claude via Claude Code. See the configuration file; the paper states this as a limitation rather than naming a version it cannot prove.

support_x_relevance.note: Rows are the entailment label of the same displayed claim (claim vs cited passage); columns are relevance (claim vs question). The paper's point sits in supported x not_relevant: well-cited, well-supported, and beside the question.

human_check.graded_by: the author, blind to the model labels and to the system's verdicts

human_relevant_rate.no_interval_quoted: Three of five strata observed 0 of 8. An earlier version reported [0.000, 0.075] from a bootstrap that could only return 0 in those strata.
human_relevant_rate.why_post_stratified: 8 items were drawn per question type, but the population is 65/64/33/14/9 across the five types; scoring the sheet naively would weight patient-FAQ claims about seven times too heavily.
